main_text.p: τὸν homo. Sic dictus a terra, e qua sumptum fuit ipsius corpus.
᾿Αδραμυττηνὸς ή ὀν Adramytténus a um. ab urbe Adramyttum, Gr. quercetum.
᾿Αδρίας ὁ Adria, nomen sinus Veneti, Gr. copiosus.
᾿Αζὼς nomen viri Matth.1. v.14. Hebr. accinctus.
᾿Αθλιῶς ὤν οἱ nomen urbis, Gr. Minervalis.
᾿Αθηνᾶ ἡς ἡ Minerva. q. ἀθλὴ non lactata. Fingebatur enim e Jovis cerebro prognata. λ vero & ν sunt litera ejusdem organi, & proinde ἀμιζάβολοι.
Αἰγύπτιος ἡ nomen regionis, ab Ægypto Beli filio sic dicta, Matth.2.15. unde Αἰγύπτιος, Ægyptius Act.7.22.
Αἰνείας ὁ Æneas, nomen viri, Gr. laudabilis.
Αἰνὼν ἡ nomen urbis ἀχλιῶν, Heb. fonticulus.
᾿Αλέξανδρος ὁ Alexander, nomen viri Gr. q.d. auxiliator.

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are only partly legible and cut off by the binding; they are not transcribed in full. Several Greek words are uncertain and may contain errors. The Greek accents and breathings are approximate.
